record.question: India will host G-20 summit in:
record.explanation: Answer C: 2022. As of the February 2019 exam, India was scheduled to host the G20 summit in 2022; an MEA publication reporting on the 2018 Buenos Aires summit documents the change that allocated India the 2022 slot. The later rotation shifted India’s hosting year to 2023. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/Images/attach/OCT_DEC_IP.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
